extracted text: The material considered in the present study is a new member of the Al–Cu family, developed in view of applications in aerospace industry (2xxx series). These alloys are specifically designed to have good mechanical properties in order to use them for structural components in aircrafts. They have copper (Cu) as the major alloying element and hardening is achieved by aging. The new alloy Al 2198 contains also lithium as an alloying element to reduce the density and increase Young's modulus and thus to save weight. Each 1 wt.% Li added to Al reduces density by 3% and increases the elastic modulus by about 6%. It has been solution heat treated, cold worked to improve strength, and artificially aged (T8 temper).
